item.title: A Spoonful Of Hits With Steve Boone of The Lovin' Spoonful
item.description: Steve Boone from The Lovin' Spoonful and his Spoonful of Hits Show: As a teenager in Long Island, Steve Boone learned guitar from his brother Skip while recovering from a car accident. He joined Skip's hot local band with future Lovin' Spoonful drummer Joe Butler. item.title: Surf 97.3 FM wants you to stay safe during this pandemic
item.description: Surf 97.3 FM hope you are doing your best to stay healthy and safe during this Covid-19 worldwide virus. Please keep 6 feet apart as best as possible at all times and also no groups of more than 10 people should be bunched together at any given time. item.title: Hope you're having a great summer so far!
item.description: Summer is finally here. Thanks for listening to our summer fun station all year 'round as we bring you a unique blend of "Sunshine Music" with Beach & Island tunes and good-time oldies Even if you can't make it to the beach, tune in to Surf 97.3 FM and www.flaglerbeachradio.com and listen to the sounds of the surf 24 hours a day.

item.title: Fall is here. Happy Halloween & Thanksgiving from Surf 97.3 FM
item.description: Cooler weather, fun-filled family holidays, tricks & treats, spooky witches, ghosts and goblins and pumpkins galore. Surf 97.3 FM wishes everyone a spooktacular Halloween and and a very happy Thanksgiving. Don't forget to carve your pumpkin in October and your turkey in November. Keep listening to Surf 97.3 FM all year 'round for community information, events and happenings in our area and the greatest music of all time. Thank you to all our loyal listeners and have a happy Fall season.

item.title: Surf 97.3 FM's First Friday Events in Veterans Park in Flagler Beach, FL.
item.description: FIRST FRIDAY FLAGLER BEACH is held monthly on the first Friday of every month year 'round. It is always a big success month after month. We host and produce this wonderful event for the town. item.title: Happy Holidays. Merry Christmas
item.description: From our radio family to your family, The Surf wishes you and your loved ones a very Merry Christmas and a healthy and prosperous New Year. Happy holidays from all of us at our station. Listen for a variety of holiday music daily in the month of December here on Surf 97.3 FM. Tis the season to wish one another joy, love and peace. May Santa Claus bring everything you wished for. Here's to a year of blessings and beyond for the upcoming year.
